scripts: START TRANSACTION; SELECT * FROM district WHERE d_w_id IN (1,2,3,4) FOR UPDATE; SELECT * FROM stock WHERE s_w_id IN (1,2) AND s_i_id BETWEEN 1 AND 100 FOR UPDATE; SELECT * FROM warehouse WHERE w_id IN (1,2,3,4) FOR UPDATE; SELECT SLEEP(10); COMMIT;

risk_assessment.impact: Induces lock waits and slow queries; bounded by 14s and limited concurrency
risk_assessment.blast_radius_controls: Read-only row locks via SELECT ... FOR UPDATE; consistent lock order across statements; COMMIT releases locks
risk_assessment.rollback_plan: Locks released automatically on COMMIT; no cleanup needed
